before: JSON export schema is type:string. Several later-added read operations omit validation/not-found error declarations. POST operations omit bounded-input 413.
after: JSON export schema must describe architecture35 section4 export object (export_schema_version, manifest_sha256, canonical_manifest, bundle). Add ErrorEnvelope declarations for reachable 404/422 and 413, preserving all43 operations and existing payloads.
reason: Architecture35 explicitly requires an export JSON object and an independently re-canonicalized manifest. Serializing that object as a JSON string would break the renderer seam and consumers. Rejecting invalid parameters and excessive request bodies is necessary; disguising them as successful responses is incorrect. Frozen kit bytes were preserved. Artifact responses were adapted to declared200 application/octet-stream; ranges are not advertised.
affected_consumers: Aradhya generated frontend client and passport renderer
required_migration: No database migration. Regenerate bundled OpenAPI/kit and generated client centrally, then rerun kit and43-operation tests.
required_tests: frontend generated client and export parsing
